results.summary: KEEP. Every proposition was checked against the current statute text on malegislature.gov and the current mass.gov PDFs of 247 CMR 6.00, 7.00, 9.00, 13.00 and 21.00 (all FlateDecode streams inflated with zero failures). Expiry terms match: Drug Store and nuclear permits December 31 of uneven years (s. 39, s. 39B, 6.05(2), 13.04(1)); non-resident Drug Store December 31st of odd years (6.09(1)(d)1); outsourcing registrations December 31 of odd years (s. 36E(d), 21.05(1)); wholesale renewal on or before December first yearly, one licence per location (s. 36B, 7.02(4)). The 150-day decision rule is correctly contrasted (no deemed approval in s. 39; deemed approval absent applicant delay in s. 39B and 13.03(8)). 6.04(9)(a)-(d), 6.04(8) and 6.18 are accurately paraphrased; no fee amount, grace period or reinstatement rule is asserted, and the section says expressly that none appears in ss. 38-39 or 6.00. 6.17 is accurate (resident Drug Store not listed; substantial compliance plus potential to reach full compliance; earliest of conversion, surrender/suspension/revocation or one year; no renewal or extension), and the worked example date arithmetic is right. 21.03(1)-(7) is accurate, including the regulation adding dispensing to the statute's distribution bar and the September 1st odd-year renewal carve-out; the section openly flags that 'first odd numbered year following issuance' is not defined, and planning on the earlier December 31 for an autumn odd-year issue is the conservative course. 9.19(21) triggers, annual cadence and two-year retention, 9.19(23)/(24) not disapplying (21), 9.24(1)-(3) and 9.25(1)-(5) are accurate; the 21-day start event is truly unstated and counting from the date of the statement of deficiency or inspection report is the earliest, hence safe, anchor. Nuclear content matches 13.02, 13.05 and 13.06 (200 hours with at most 60 laboratory; three months full-time or 500 hours; affidavit; ten-day employment report; three-year records; attendance whenever open), and avoids citing the duplicated paragraph numbers in 13.05. Wholesale content matches 7.02(5)-(9), 7.03(1) 15-day report copy and 7.04(9)(b). Non-resident content matches s. 39D, s. 39J(b)-(e), 6.02(4), 6.09(1) and (4) and 9.20; the section correctly notes s. 39J(c) and 6.02(4) are worded differently and gives the safe course of licensing before shipping any medication. All five practice questions (MA-Q-0221, 0222, 0364, 0367, 0368) are answerable from the section and not contradicted by it or by their explanations. No legal defect found.
